title: Father's Final Guidance
next_chapter_hook: In the instant Chen Xuan's voice abruptly ceased, a pair of crimson eyes suddenly opened in the darkness deep within the seal—an existence imprisoned for ten thousand years, quietly awakening following the reunion of father and son.

text.content: The voice struck like thunder into his ears, and Chen Ji's body froze instantly. All light within the seal extinguished, only the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm glowing with faint fluorescence, illuminating his pallid face in alternating brightness and shadow. 'Father...' His voice was hoarse beyond measure, his knees involuntarily pressing to the ground, his forehead touching the cold stone surface. He had waited eighteen long years for this voice, transforming from a naive child into the废物模样 he now embodied. Countless midnight dreams had painted visions of his father's presence, yet hearing the actual sound left him paralyzed, uncertain how to respond.

Chen Xuan's voice rang out again, tinged with bitter amusement: 'I understand you harbor countless questions. These eighteen years of silence, I owe you greatly. Yet time grows short—some truths must be spoken before I fade.' Chen Ji lifted his head sharply, pupils contracting—fade? Was his father already... 'Don't wear that expression,' Chen Xuan continued, as if perceiving his son's anguish through the seal. 'This remnant of my spirit was always meant as your final gift. Once I reveal the truth, I'll completely merge into your heavenly fate.'

dialogue.content: 'Tell me what?' Chen Ji forced himself to remain composed, though his voice carried a delicate tremor. 'The true origins of the Tianji Record? The nature of the shackles? Or... the existence that has been manipulating everything from the shadows?' His jaw clenched as he spoke those final words—the forbidden domain he had touched only after years of solitary struggle.

text.content: 'You've progressed further than I imagined.' Chen Xuan's voice carried increased relief. 'Since you've already touched the edge of that existence, I'll speak directly—the Tianji Record is no ordinary inheritance. It possesses a dual nature.' A low rumble echoed from the depths of the seal, as if some force was resonating. Chen Ji felt the fragment in his palm scalding intensely, as an arcane message poured directly into his consciousness: the so-called dual nature is the unity of 'prophecy' and 'witnessing.' The Tianji Record can foresee the future, but it only becomes a certainty after being witnessed.

'What does this mean?' Chen Ji gripped the fragment tightly, oblivious to the burns seared into his palm. Chen Xuan's voice turned grave: 'It means the future you see is not true destined fate—it is merely one among countless possibilities. And that existence... the Heavenly Eye, it chose prophets across generations precisely to借用这种'witnessing' power, transforming possibilities into certainties, and variables into its chess game.' Chen Ji shuddered violently, countless past confusions connecting into a coherent line: why the Tianji Record's prophecies always deviated at critical moments, and why the more he used it, the more he felt himself sinking into a deeper vortex.

dialogue.content: 'So the so-called shackles...' Chen Ji's voice tightened, each word seemingly squeezed from his throat. 'Are they merely means for that existence to control prophets? Making me believe I'm setting up a game, when in reality I'm merely a piece on its chessboard?' He suddenly recalled those eerie prophetic visions, always blurred at the most critical moments, as if some force was deliberately obscuring the truth.

text.content: 'Not just shackles.' Chen Xuan's voice suddenly dropped, carrying ten thousand years of vicissitudes. 'The true nature of the shackles is how it devours heavenly fate. Every instance a prophet uses the Tianji Record, the heavenly fate consumed is absorbed by that existence, becoming nourishment for maintaining the heaven's mechanism. The more you consume, the stronger it becomes, and you... will ultimately become its new vessel.' Chen Ji stood frozen, Mo Xiansheng's words flashing through his mind—'The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the destined fatal backlash.' So the so-called backlash was never the cost of the Tianji Record itself, but that existence lurking behind the scenes harvesting his life.

The seal began to violently shake, debris raining from the ceiling. Chen Xuan's voice grew urgent: 'Time is running out, let me be brief. Ten thousand years ago, when your grandfather Chen Tianming and I discovered the truth, we too were trapped in a desperate situation. But we left behind a contingency.' Chen Ji lifted his head sharply, eyes blazing with fervent light. 'What is the contingency?' He practically roared. Chen Xuan's laughter echoed in the vast sealed space: 'That bloodline power sealed within you is the key to breaking the situation. I sealed it in your body for eighteen years precisely so it could completely merge with your soul—it can block the Heavenly Eye's perception.'

Chen Ji unconsciously circulated the spiritual energy within his body, indeed sensing an unfelt warmth deep in his dantian beginning to awaken. That power was like a seed sleeping for ten thousand years, responding to its master's call by slowly unfurling its branches, an unprecedented clarity instantly enveloping his consciousness. 'This is the Chen family bloodline...' Chen Ji murmured. 'Grandfather and father spent two generations just to cultivate this seed?' Chen Xuan's voice softened: 'Because you are my son, our greatest hope for opposing that existence.'

dialogue.content: 'But I don't want to merely inherit.' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice unexpectedly calm. 'Father, your and grandfather's layout is certainly magnificent, but you've always been trying to evade that existence's perception. And I...' He slowly rose to his feet, eyes glittering with a distinctly different light from his ancestors. 'What I want is to completely slay it. Can you tell me where the Heavenly Eye's true body is?' A brief silence fell within the seal, then Chen Xuan let out a complex, lengthy sigh: 'You child... are even more insane than I imagined.'

text.content: 'Insane?' A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips. 'A废物 who can't even protect his own sister, what right does he have to speak of inheritance? I refuse to be a carefully cultivated chess piece—I want to be the one who plays the game.' His voice echoed in the vast sealed space, carrying undeniable resolve. 'Father, if you're willing to tell me, I will inherit this power; but if you expect me to walk the path you've laid out, I'm afraid you'll be disappointed.' The light within the seal suddenly brightened, as if responding to his world-shaking declaration.

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's voice fell silent for a moment, then let out a liberated sigh: 'Good, a true son of the Chen family. Since you possess such ambition, your father will give you the final trump card.' From the depths of the seal, an ancient jade slip floated out slowly. 'This is the 'Destiny Reversing Talisman' I forged at the cost of all my cultivation. At critical moments, it can block the Heavenly Eye's perception for three breaths. Three breaths of time are enough for you to take any action that changes destiny. But Chen Ji, I must ask you one more time—are you prepared? The road ahead is more perilous than you can imagine.'

choices.description: Accept the jade slip, solemnly promise to use this power carefully, proceeding cautiously along the path laid by his ancestors.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the Expectations of Three Generations of the Chen Family
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the 'Destiny Reversing Talisman,' unlocking the complete awakening state of the Chen family bloodline
choices.risk_hint: Must endure the heavenly fate backlash accumulated by generations of ancestors

text.content: Chen Ji took the warm jade slip with both hands, sensing the vast power contained within. The moment the jade slip entered his palm, countless scenes flashed through his mind like a carousel—grandfather Chen Tianming setting up a grand scheme on the primordial battlefield, father Chen Xuan confronting the Heavenly Eye before the seal, and a little girl crying in darkness... Chen Nian. His eye sockets suddenly reddened, his knuckles white from tension. 'I understand.' His voice was low and firm. 'No matter how arduous the road ahead, I will walk it. For grandfather's layout, for father's painstaking efforts, and more importantly... to bring my sister back.'

choices.description: Accept the jade slip but explicitly state it will be used in his own way, not limited by his ancestors' plans.
choices.visible_cost: May be judged as rebellious by his ancestors' remnants
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the 'Destiny Reversing Talisman' while retaining independent judgment, can overturn the established chess game at any time
choices.risk_hint: Losing part of the accumulated blessings from generations of the Chen family

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, but he did not bow in submission as his father had expected. He stared directly at the ball of light, as if making eye contact with Chen Xuan: "Father, I accept this power, but I will not use it in the way you preset. You and Grandfather have plotted for ten thousand years, yet still failed to break free from that existence's control—proving the old path leads nowhere." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "I will use my own way, to walk a path no one has ever walked." From the depths of the seal came a soft sigh, and within the light seemed to be a pair of gentle hands stroking the top of his head.

The light within the seal began to rapidly dissipate, Chen Xuan's figure becoming increasingly translucent before Chen Ji's eyes. This father who had given everything for his son revealed a serene smile at the final moment: "Chen Ji, this is all your father can do for you. Remember, what the Heavenly Eye fears most is not power, but..." "What?" Chen Ji pressed urgently. Chen Xuan's voice had become like a dying ember in the wind, intermittent: "It is... those who do not believe in fate... your sister... she is more important than you realize... find her..." The last word remained unspoken as the light finally extinguished, leaving behind an abyss of darkness and cold.

Chen Ji knelt motionless, the Jade Slip and faded fragment pressed between his palms. Within the seal, frigid winds howled, lifting his thin garments. Eighteen years of anticipation had yielded only a fleeting moment of connection. Three generations of familial sacrifice had condensed into this small Jade Slip cradled in his palm. A deep breath escaped his lips as he gradually rose. "My sister is more important than I imagined..." he murmured, replaying his father's final words. The blurred image of Chen Nian materialized in his thoughts. Among all the visions of her, why did her face always remain indistinct? Could she be the key to breaking this deadlock?

choice.prompt: At this moment, an uncanny tremor erupted from the seal's depths. Chen Ji lifted his head abruptly, sensing the terrifying aura within that trembling—a presence far more ancient and malevolent than the Heavenly Eye. His instinct screamed to flee with the intelligence, yet a deeper intuition warned him that this entity had already perceived the disturbance. Without decisive action, the entire ruin risked becoming a fatal trap.

choices.text: Activate the Counter-Fate Talisman to infiltrate and retreat
choices.description: Consume precious three breaths of concealment time, retreat quietly while that existence has not fully awakened, and bring the intelligence out.
choices.visible_cost: Consume one use of the Counter-Fate Talisman
choices.visible_reward: Safely retreat from the ruins, completely preserving the key intelligence from Chen Xuan's final words
choices.risk_hint: The Counter-Fate Talisman has only one use remaining

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer, pouring spiritual energy into the Jade Slip. A faint golden barrier instantly enveloped him, severing connection with the outside world. He sensed the crimson eyes scanning his location in the darkness, yet encountering only an empty void. The three breaths elapsed in an instant, and as the barrier dissolved, he had already slipped into a hidden passage. A furious roar echoed behind him, shaking the entire ruin. "That was close..." he exhaled, wiping cold sweat from his brow, his pace unrelenting. His father's final words resonated in his mind, while the mystery of his sister perhaps lay concealed within some corner of the Holy Sect.

choices.description: Risk staying in place to observe what this awakening existence truly is, perhaps useful intelligence can be found.
choices.visible_cost: May be discovered and severely wounded
choices.visible_reward: May discover this existence's weakness or its connection to the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Without Counter-Fate Talisman protection, exposure risk is extremely high

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, suppressing his flight impulse, and concealed himself behind a massive stone. The oppressive presence drew nearer, and from the darkness emerged a pair of crimson eyes. The entity's appearance defied conventional description—an infinite cascade of overlapping eyes, each radiating suffocating pressure. "Another chess piece," the being murmured, seemingly自言自语. "Chen Xuan's whelp? Interesting, your father's scent was quite unpleasant." Chen Ji's hair stood on end, yet he forced himself to remain motionless. His instincts whispered that this entity shared some intricate connection with the Heavenly Eye.

Regardless of his decision, the ruins' trembling intensified. Gazing at the collapsing ceiling, Chen Ji found himself calculating rapidly. His father had granted him power, truth, hope, yet simultaneously presented an agonizing choice: follow the ancestors' cautious strategy or forge an unprecedented, perilous path. The image of Chen Nian flickered in his thoughts—the little girl who had screamed for her brother when taken away. Where could she possibly be now? "No matter," he murmured, a resolute glint emerging in his eyes. "First, escape. Then, find her."

choice.prompt: Just as Chen Ji was about to leave the seal space, his peripheral vision caught a concealed groove in the stone wall. Faint characters glimmered within the groove, barely visible under the dim light. That handwriting... belonged to his father! Chen Ji's footsteps faltered, an indescribable emotion surging through him. Why had his father inscribed this information here when he could have directly told him? Unless... even his father could not reveal these secrets directly?

choices.text: Carefully examine the stone wall characters
choices.description: Risk approaching to identify those lines of text, even if it might delay retreat time.
choices.visible_reward: May discover hidden intelligence left by father
choices.risk_hint: Ruin collapse intensifies, may become trapped

text.content: Chen Ji strode toward the groove, spiritual energy coalescing at his fingertips to provide illumination. The stone wall's inscriptions gradually became distinct—"My son, if you read these words, it means your father has perished. Nian is not your blood sister, but a fragment of the Heavenly Eye itself. She is both the key to breaking this impasse and the ultimate catastrophe. Whether to save or destroy her rests entirely upon your shoulders." Chen Ji stood frozen, as if struck by lightning. The image of that little girl who always called out "Brother" suddenly became impossibly unfamiliar. A fragment of the Heavenly Eye? The ultimate catastrophe? Was his sister not an ordinary person from the very beginning?

choices.text: After memorizing the location, immediately retreat
choices.description: After confirming it was information left by his father, he would retreat first and investigate later.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength and retreat safely, allowing for a leisurely investigation in the future
choices.risk_hint: The ruins might be sealed off, and missing this opportunity means never having another chance

text.content: Chen Ji barely restrained his impulse, firmly memorizing the location of that groove in his heart. He cast one final glance at those faint characters etched in stone, then turned and rushed toward the exit. A deafening roar erupted behind him as the dome finally collapsed completely. Yet he had already devised a plan - his father had deliberately inscribed those words in a place both conspicuous and inconspicuous, which surely held profound meaning. When his strength was sufficient and his preparations were thorough, he would return to unravel this secret. For now, the most critical thing was to survive and escape this place.

Chen Ji sprinted desperately, just managing to burst through the exit before the entire ruin collapsed. Outside, the sky hung heavy and overcast, dark clouds gathering ominously without warning. Standing beyond the ruins, he gazed back at the ancient architecture slowly sinking into the earth, his heart churning with mixed emotions. His father was gone, taking with him all secrets and regrets, yet leaving behind an even heavier burden. Chen Nian, the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the truth behind the shackles... all these threads tangled into a chaotic mess in his mind. "But at least I have a direction now." he murmured, a bitter smile playing subtly on his lips. "And more importantly, I'm still alive."

He spread open his palm, gazing at the warm Reverse Fate Talisman and the dim fragment. His father's lingering will had completely dissipated, yet those parting words seared themselves into his soul like an indelible brand. The Tianji Record possessed dual nature, the shackles were pathways for the Eye of Heavenly Dao to absorb Heavenly Fate, Chen Nian was an existence beyond imagination... this intelligence alone could overturn the entire cultivation world's understanding. What he needed to do now was piece these fragments into a complete picture, and then - personally sever that thread of fate suspended above all prophets. "Wait for me, Eye of Heavenly Dao." he said quietly, his voice carrying a boldness entirely different from his ancestors. "Your chess game ends today, with me."

Just then, the fragment in his palm suddenly grew warm. Chen Ji looked down to see faint patterns reappearing on the originally dim page - that was Mo Xiansheng's mark. His heart stirred as he attempted to channel spiritual energy into it. A familiar voice rang in his mind: "Well done, lad. It seems you've found what that old codger left behind." Mo Xiansheng paused, his tone turning profound. "But it appears you haven't fully digested that information yet. No matter, some things can't be rushed. However, there's one thing I must warn you about - the commotion from the ruins' collapse was too great. I'm afraid it's already alerted certain people who shouldn't have been."

Before the words finished, several spiritual lights suddenly flickered across the distant horizon. Chen Ji's pupils contracted - with his keen vision, he could clearly identify what those were - unique spiritual fluctuations exclusive to sect experts, and not just one or two. "That was quick." he coldly harrumphed, yet without any panic. He tucked the fragment back into his sleeve, his figure flickering as he vanished into the forest shadows nearby. While walking, he thought: Ye Qing had mentioned that the Demonic Path mist could conceal the Tianji Record's aura. Perhaps it was time to contact her. As for these people before him... "Let them search all they want." A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. "I have plenty to do and no time to play games with them."

Night deepened as Chen Ji made camp in a secluded mountain cave. He sat cross-legged, meticulously sorting through the day's gains in his mind. His father's words, the secrets on the stone walls, and that terrifying existence awakened within the ruins... all clues pointed in the same direction: the Holy Sect. That faction which had taken Chen Nian, that behemoth intricately connected to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. He suddenly recalled Su Qingyao mentioning that the Holy Sect was plotting some grand scheme recently. Could all of this be related to Chen Nian? "Never mind." He opened his eyes, his gaze resolute. "Since my sister is the key to breaking the deadlock, I'll rescue her first."

Just as he prepared to rise and leave, a soft footstep echoed outside the cave. Chen Ji's entire body tensed, spiritual energy gathering at his fingertips. However, in the next instant, his expression shifted微妙ly - for he caught a familiar ethereal fragrance, the unique scent belonging to Ye Qing. "The Demonic Path Saintess arrives swiftly." He relaxed his guard, smiling meaningfully toward the cave entrance. "What, come to mock me or to discuss cooperation?" From the darkness, a graceful silhouette emerged slowly. Ye Qing's cool yet playful voice rang out: "Neither. I've come to tell you some good news - regarding your sister's whereabouts."
